scope: Pre-fix RTL simulation; no hardware access or physical noise conclusion
method: Current midi_qt2160_client plus the existing open-drain pin-level slave model; temporary /dev/stdin testbench

polling.interpretation: A held shared CHANGE bypassed the configured polling wait. Both intervals were shorter than the QT2160 16 ms minimum matrix cycle.

post_configuration_reset.injection: During CAL_WAIT after configuration readback, set general status to 0x81 and restore slider control register 20 to its reset value 0x00.
post_configuration_reset.interpretation: The former first-status RESET mask accepted a sample after the verified slider configuration had been lost.

limits: These reproductions establish software scheduling and reset-window defects. They do not prove that either defect is the sole cause of the board's reported false touches or position jitter.
